question.text: 'Vindhya Debt AIF' (Cat II) has a corpus of INR 150 crore. What is the minimum continuing sponsor commitment?

explanation.text: The Logic: For Category I/II AIFs, the sponsor or manager continuing interest is not less than 2.5% of corpus or INR 5 crore, whichever is lower. 2.5% x INR 150 cr = INR 3.75 crore; INR 5 crore is higher. The lower of the two is INR 3.75 crore. The Trap: 1% understates. INR 5 crore flat ignores the 'lower of' rule. 5% is not the Cat I/II rule. Note: The workbook expresses the Cat I/II continuing interest as 2.5% of corpus or INR 5 crore, whichever is lower.
